cues.en: A million dollar prize, Paul. I'm double-checking to make sure they haven't changed any details since they told us last time. One million in US dollars for first prize. That is for the winner. One million dollars for winning Dota. It's going to be huge. Dota2.com, the total town is up to. Our website will actually change for the next 24 hours as well. So you guys can actually read all the details. The day I transformed into an adult was the day I started playing Dota. It's times like when you go out on the stage, you...
cues.zh: 一百万美元的奖金啊，Paul。我在反复核对，确保他们自上次通知后没有改动任何细节。冠军奖金是一百万美元。属于最终的胜者。赢下 Dota 就能拿到一百万美元。这绝对会引爆全场。Dota2.com 上，倒计时也已经开启。接下来的 24 小时里，我们的网站也会同步更新。这样大家就能看到所有的详细信息。我长大成人的那一天，就是我开始打 Dota 的那一天。就像当你走上舞台的那一刻，你……

cues.en: represent your country for something, you get the prize. It's the amount of satisfaction and achievement that nothing else can give you. Something I definitely not regret ever doing. Gaming is simply the proudest thing about it. It can be called gamer, but for me, it's something different. One way to forget about playing is to do something that you will be in completely. So, computer games, for me, it was everything.
cues.zh: 代表自己的国家出征，赢下大奖。那种满足感和成就感，是任何其他事情都给不了你的。这是我绝对不会后悔去做的事。打游戏就是最让我自豪的事情。你可以把这叫作玩家，但对我来说，它远不止于此。想要忘掉一切，办法就是全心全意沉浸在某件事里。所以，电脑游戏对我而言就是一切。

cues.en: This is my career. I chose to do it for so long. Success in my eyes is always based off on how other people see you, the eyes of the public, and it's up to them. It's important to be doing things that you love and you really appreciate because that's your passion, man. You should really work for your passion. Okay, guys, you have seven minutes to set everything up, and there we go. This is the first time I really wanted to take something seriously and do something good for my life. Ten years ago...
cues.zh: 这就是我的事业。我选择坚持了这么久。在我眼里，成功往往取决于别人怎么看你，取决于大众的眼光，这由他们说了算。做自己热爱且真正珍惜的事情至关重要，因为那是你的热情所在，兄弟。你真的应该为自己的热爱而奋斗。好了大家，你们有七分钟时间调试设备，马上就要开始了。这是我人生中第一次真正想要认真对待一件事，想为自己的人生做出一番成绩。十年前……

cues.en: Competitive gaming wasn't even really a thing. You would play for fun against your friends. Maybe you'd play for a cup of coffee or whatever you wanted. When I started playing, we've been fighting for 24 bottles of beer as a first place. I'm not joking. From there, though, online hacking. And all of a sudden, you weren't just trying to be the best on your block. Now you're trying to be the best in the world. And that opened up competitive gaming to a whole new landscape.
cues.zh: 竞技游戏当时根本还不算个事儿。你就是跟朋友打着玩，可能赌一杯咖啡，或者随便什么。我刚开始打的时候，我们争第一名，奖品是24瓶啤酒。我没开玩笑。不过从那以后，就变成线上了。突然之间，你不只是想当街区里最强的，而是想当世界最强。这一下子把竞技游戏带进了一个全新的格局。

cues.en: and one of the games really leading the way is Dota. Dota is sort of a combination of football, soccer for the Americans and chess. This is probably how I would try to explain Dota to someone who is not familiar with it. At least that's what I did to my parents. Dota is a game of momentum. You as five players try and battle against the other five players' momentum. Every single player controls one unit.
cues.zh: 真正领跑的游戏之一就是 Dota。Dota 有点像足球（美国人叫 soccer）和国际象棋的结合。如果要向不熟悉的人解释 Dota，我大概会这么说。至少我就是这么跟我爸妈解释的。Dota 是一个关于势头的游戏。你们五个人要对抗另外五个人的势头。每名玩家控制一个单位。

cues.en: And the main objective of the game is to destroy the final enemy building, which is called the Ancient. Everything else that happens in the meantime is your amazing filler of a game. You could play 100 heroes in conjunction with 99 other heroes. It's just non-stop possibilities and it's so much fun. It's like the same map every single time, but it literally never gets boring. I would say Dota is a way of life.
cues.zh: 游戏的主要目标就是摧毁敌方最后一栋建筑，叫做遗迹。与此同时发生的一切，都是这场精彩游戏的填充内容。你可以让100个英雄和另外99个英雄相互搭配。可能性停不下来，而且特别好玩。地图每次看起来都一样，但它真的从不无聊。我会说，Dota 是一种生活方式。

cues.en: When the prizes started coming, I was like, well, we have tournaments, so obviously some people are going to come and say, this is a great game, let's play it, let's put money in it. And it started progressing each year. Those at the top level, they just do lots of calculations in their head. Something like a beautiful mind, where you see all kinds of things, and using all this information, make your next move. I see it in a lot of ways, similar to basketball.
cues.zh: 奖金开始出现时，我就想，既然有比赛，那显然会有人过来说，这游戏很棒，咱们来玩，往里投钱。然后它每年都在发展。顶尖选手就是会在脑子里做大量计算。有点像《美丽心灵》，你能看到各种东西，再利用所有这些信息决定下一步。我觉得它在很多方面都像篮球。

cues.en: Just like a five-on-five game where you kind of have to work together and utilize each other's strengths and synergizing everything together. The teamwork and the trust and sacrifice, those are all true for every single team sport. Dodora is a game that unites everybody. It doesn't matter what country you're from, what race you are. It's kind of like a bond that is shared. And when you're part of this tight-knit group of people, it's like having a second family. That's something you never let go. Everyone's searching for something.
cues.zh: 就像五对五的比赛，你必须彼此配合，发挥各自的优势，把一切协同起来。团队合作、信任和牺牲，这些对每一项团队运动来说都是真实存在的。Dodora 是一款能让所有人团结起来的游戏。不管你来自哪个国家，也不管你是什么种族，都没有关系。它就像一种共同的纽带。当你成为这个紧密群体的一员时，就像拥有了第二个家庭。这是你永远不会放手的东西。每个人都在寻找某种东西。

cues.en: fulfillment, fame, satisfaction. It gives you the ability to become someone else. A someone who is powerful, who can take down five opponents, express their creativity, break the rules without actually getting arrested. All of these reasons are in there somewhere. The player himself might not even know. He might not even understand it himself. But it's there. Gaming fulfills my competitive need.
cues.zh: 成就感、名望、满足感。它让你有能力成为另一个人，一个强大的人，一个能击败五名对手、表达创造力、打破规则却不会真的被逮捕的人。所有这些理由，或多或少都包含在其中。玩家自己甚至可能都不知道，也未必真正理解。但它确实存在。游戏满足了我的竞争需求。

cues.en: I'm a very competitive person. When it comes to sports, I consider gaming a sport. So I use my competitiveness and I fuel it with Dota. So it fulfills that side of me completely. Fer is one of the best in America, if not the best. He has a lot of experience. He's one of the old hogs, basically. And he's generally just a calm guy. So in my opinion, that's a strength. Really good basketball player member. My coach was watching him play and just talk about picking him up the next year when he came in. Always had nothing but good things to say. But he wasn't picked on the team, just...
cues.zh: 我是个竞争心很强的人。说到体育运动，我认为游戏也是一项运动。所以我把自己的竞争心投入 Dota，让它得到充分释放。它完全满足了我的这一面。Fer 是美国最优秀的选手之一，甚至可能就是最优秀的。他经验丰富，基本上算是老将了。而且他通常都很冷静。所以在我看来，这是他的优势。我记得他是个非常出色的篮球运动员。我的教练当时看着他打球，还一直说等他下一年进队时要把他招进来。他总是对他赞不绝口。但他没有被选进球队，只是……

cues.en: The reason was, yeah, I just wasn't tall enough, I guess. So I know that I found the gaming. I really devoted it in that stuff and just found something else at work. I was your typical parent, Clinton. You're spending too much time playing computer games. You need to go to school. You need to go to college. And he would tell me, I want to be able to play games and get paid for it. Now, he said this at a very young age before Dota ever came along. And I thought, well, you know.
cues.zh: 原因嘛，我想就是我不够高。后来我发现了游戏，真的投入进去，也在工作中找到了别的东西。我那时就是典型家长，Clinton。你花太多时间打电脑游戏了，你得去上学，得上大学。他会跟我说，我想能打游戏还靠这个赚钱。他说这话时年纪很小，Dota还没出现。我当时想，嗯，你懂的。

cues.en: He's going to grow out of it. He's going to get sick and tired of sitting there in front of that computer and playing. Never did. Never did. In Singapore, the families actually put a lot of stress on us in terms of our education. I would say it's been tough on me trying to juggle both studies and gaming at the same time. My grades have dropped for like two years already and my parents have computed the gaming as a cause for it. I mean, there was this phrase that they used.
cues.zh: 他长大就会好的。他总有一天会厌倦坐在电脑前打游戏。从来没有。从来没有。在新加坡，家庭其实给我们的教育压力很大。我想说，同时兼顾学业和游戏对我来说很难。我的成绩已经掉了大概两年了，我父母把原因归到游戏上。我是说，他们用过这样一句话。

cues.en: He said gaming would be the death of you one day. He's a great player and a great captain. I would say he's the top player in Singapore. Easily. My parents and my family, they don't actually speak much of my gaming career. They don't tell their friends and my other relatives that I'm actually that good at my games. All along, they have only been bragging about my studies because I was not used to being an A student. They go on and on and it seemed like that was the only thing that they could ever be proud of.
cues.zh: 他说，打游戏总有一天会害了你。他是个很棒的选手，也是个很棒的队长。我会说他是新加坡顶尖的选手，轻松排第一。我父母和家人其实不太提我的游戏生涯。他们不会告诉朋友和其他亲戚我游戏打得那么好。一直以来，他们只夸我的学业，因为我不习惯当全A学生。他们一直说个不停，好像那是他们唯一能骄傲的事。

cues.en: Actually, there's only been one person that has always been very supportive of me gaming. And that was my ex-girlfriend, Hoya. She's from the female daughter team in Singapore. There are a lot of things that we share in life, so many things. In my case, it felt really good to have someone who truly appreciated what you did best and loved you for it. She's aware of what I'm doing and what I'm passionate about. The pickup was her decision and I respected it.
cues.zh: 其实，一直非常支持我打游戏的只有一个人。那就是我前女友 Hoya。她来自新加坡的女子战队。我们在生活中有很多共同点，非常多。对我来说，能有一个人真正欣赏你最擅长的事，并因此爱你，感觉真的很好。她知道我在做什么、我热爱什么。分手是她的决定，我尊重它。

cues.en: We've been together for close to three years and ever since the breakup, I haven't gotten married. I recall the last time she spoke to me, she named me as a bastard. You're not in contact anymore, but life goes on. I'm from Ukraine. My nickname is Dendi. I finished my university and I'm just playing computer games right now.
cues.zh: 我们在一起快三年了，分手之后我一直没结婚。我记得她最后一次跟我说话时，骂我是混蛋。我们不再联系了，但生活还要继续。我来自乌克兰。我的昵称是 Dendi。我读完了大学，现在只是在打电脑游戏。

cues.en: When we were growing up, it wasn't a good time financially for our family. But my grandma helped us to get our first computer in 1997, early, comparing it with other kids in Ukraine. We got visitors.
cues.zh: 我们小时候，家里经济条件不太好。但 1997 年，奶奶帮我们买了第一台电脑；跟乌克兰其他孩子相比，这算很早的。家里常来客人。

cues.en: Every day, the friends of my older brother used to come to visit us and we were playing games. During all his conscious life, we were trying to stop him from playing.
cues.zh: 以前我哥哥的朋友每天都会来我们家，我们一起打游戏。在他有记忆以来的整个人生里，我们一直想阻止他打游戏。

cues.en: We were hiding our computer core everywhere in our apartment, but he always found it. She stopped preventing him from playing Dota. She gave Dendy the freedom to choose.
cues.zh: 我们把电脑主机藏在公寓的各个地方，但他总能找到。她不再阻止他打 Dota。她给了 Dendy 选择的自由。

cues.en: What is the best for him in his life? The tournaments back then were like really low prizes and a lot of prize money didn't even get to the players. There's been a lot of scams with managers and stuff like that. There were like some rumors that it's going to be like $50,000 first place and everyone was going like, nah, it's not going to be like that. Watch the forums go nuts, guys. Watch the forums go nuts. It is actually confirmed. It is off the frickin' hook.
cues.zh: 对他的人生来说，什么才是最好的选择？当时的比赛奖金少得可怜，很多甚至根本发不到选手手里。还有不少经理卷钱跑路之类的骗局。之前有传言说冠军能拿 5 万美元，大家还都在说“拉倒吧，绝不可能”。结果论坛彻底炸锅了，伙计们。论坛全炸了。这消息居然是真的。简直太疯狂了。

cues.en: $1.6 million prize pool. As for the winner, $1 million for winning Dota. Dota, the game I've played for five years now, which I played for fun for some food money or whatever, you know. OK, it's actually getting big. It's the largest prize pool of any gaming competition to date. It just felt like the start of something big, like a revolution. You know, we had everything we needed.
cues.zh: 160 万美元总奖池。而 Dota 冠军独得 100 万。Dota，这款我已经打了五年的游戏，以前玩就是图个乐子、赚点饭钱之类的。好吧，这回真的做大了。这是迄今为止所有电竞比赛里最高的奖金池。感觉就像是某种大事、一场革命的开端。你看，我们所需的一切都齐备了。

cues.en: for the game to become big and respected as an e-porter. It would kind of like vindicate us. We're not just playing because we are addicted. There's a goal, a motive that we can actually reach out and grab if we are good enough. Over in Asia, professional gamers are treated like rock stars. It's a viable career opportunity. They actually live in gamer houses, so it's set up to be a thing all year long.
cues.zh: 足以让这款游戏走向辉煌，让电竞选手赢得尊重。这在某种程度上为我们正了名。我们打比赛不只是因为网瘾。有了这个目标和动力，只要实力够强，我们就真的能触手可及。在亚洲，职业选手像摇滚明星一样受欢迎。这成了一个切实可行的职业出路。他们真正住在训练基地里，一年到头都在专业化运转。

cues.en: I think their approach to practice is that it's like a day job. The fan base is immense. It probably is as big as the whole Western audience together, or even more than that. So now you really have to play good, you really have to try hard. It's first place, it's go big or go home. The big teams get big money, but the ninth to sixteenth place are nothing, and their salaries are not worth considering. While in sports, you have a salary that you can live off.
cues.zh: 我觉得他们把训练当作一份正职工作来做。粉丝群体非常庞大。可能比整个西方观众加起来还要多，甚至远超于此。所以现在你必须打出好成绩，必须全力以赴。不拿第一，就只能卷铺盖走人。顶尖强队赚得盆满钵满，但第 9 到第 16 名就什么都不是，微薄的工资根本不值一提。而在传统体育里，你起码能有一份足以维生的薪水。

cues.en: With pro gaming, I think that's one of the toughest parts is living game to game. It's like living paycheck to paycheck. Like, I have to win. If I don't win, I don't get paid. That's a tough living for anybody. It doesn't matter what you're doing. When your child wants to become a professional gamer, you don't have any history to look back on, like other sports. I don't know anybody who's made a living at gaming. So it's kind of a scary thing when you see your kid putting...
cues.zh: 说到职业电竞，我觉得最难熬的一点就是得一场接一场地打比赛过日子。就像靠每次发薪水撑到下次发薪日一样。比如说，我必须赢。不赢就拿不到钱。不管做什么，这对任何人来说都很难熬。不管你干的是哪一行。当你的孩子想成为职业电竞选手时，你没有像其他运动那样可以借鉴的历史。我不认识有谁靠打游戏谋生。所以当你看到自己的孩子投入……这会有点吓人。

cues.en: their whole life into gaming and not college and not the traditional things, what if nothing comes of it? Regarding the age, I think yes. 25, 26 years, it's absolutely maximum for esports. Because 27, 28, 29, 30, your reaction time is lowering and you can't click so much, you know, as the kids do.
cues.zh: 他们把一生都投入游戏，而不是大学、不是传统的东西，万一什么都没成呢？至于年龄，我认为是的。25、26岁，绝对是电竞的极限了。因为到了27、28、29、30岁，你的反应速度在下降，你没法像那些孩子们一样点那么快。

cues.en: A lot of financial responsibilities are laid upon me right now, require me to be successful in something or have a job. So it's pretty critical that I am successful if I want to keep continuing the gaming career.
cues.zh: 现在很多经济责任压在我身上，要求我必须在某件事上成功，或者有份工作。所以如果我想继续走游戏职业生涯，成功就非常关键。

cues.en: Am I right? Sorry? Am I right? I hate one multi-millionaire. For gaming. Sorry, you are not. What is your view? What is your plan? That is more important. I mean, we speak ourselves. We speak our friend. This is your choice. What do you want me to say?
cues.zh: 我说得对吗？什么？我说得对吗？我讨厌某个千万富翁。做游戏的。抱歉，你不是。你怎么看？你有什么计划？那才更重要。我是说，我们为自己发声。为朋友发声。这是你的选择。你想让我说什么？

cues.en: If I'm going to win this tournament, my first thought would be I will call my ex-girlfriend. Things got a bit bad between us, but right now, for me, if I'm going to win this tournament, my first thought would be that I will call her, I will tell her about it, and I want to share this moment with her. This tournament is going to be a moment in every gamer's life. Everything that you've been doing is building up, and it's going to happen over one week. And then, if it's not one week anymore, it's one game.
cues.zh: 如果我要赢下这场比赛，我第一个想到的就是给我的前女友打电话。我们之间的关系变得有点糟，但现在对我来说，如果我要赢下这场比赛，我第一个想到的就是打电话给她，告诉她这件事，我想和她分享这一刻。这场比赛将会成为每个玩家一生中的一个重要时刻。你一直以来所做的一切都在为这一刻积蓄力量，而这一切将在一周内发生。然后，如果不再是一周，那就是一场比赛。

cues.en: And then it's not that one game, it's that one moment in the game. And then that one moment in the game is where it's gonna finish. And how's it gonna finish? Are you gonna be holding up a trophy? Or are you gonna be the most disappointed that you've ever been? It's Tuesday, so one day before the event, we already have a lot of setup. We have a lot of computer setup right here. Whole booth construction pretty much finished. So five players per side, they can see each other through the glass. They can't hear each other. This booth...
cues.zh: 胜负往往不在于整场比赛，而在于赛中的那一个瞬间。而就是比赛中的那一个瞬间，将决定最终的结局。结局会是怎样？是高举奖杯？还是品尝前所未有的失落？今天是周二，距离开赛还有一天，我们已经做好了很多准备。这边架设了大量的电脑。整个对战房的搭建也基本完工。每队五名选手，他们透过玻璃能看到对方，但听不到彼此的声音。这个对战房……

cues.en: It sound-proofed up, plus the whole setup here. If you look from above, it looks exactly like a donut map. And this is the myth. This is where it all happens. A few teams have already arrived this morning. We had a lot of teams from Singapore. We had China, we had Malaysia coming in, and Russia. And tomorrow it's finally happening. We are here live at Gamescom 2011 in beautiful Cologne. It's the first day of the event.
cues.zh: 做好了全方位隔音，加上这里的整个布置。如果从上方俯瞰，它看起来就像一张甜甜圈地图。这就是传奇之地，一切都将在这里上演。今天上午已经有几支队伍抵达了。有许多来自新加坡的队伍，中国、马来西亚以及俄罗斯的战队也陆续进驻。明天，大战终于要打响了。我们正在美丽的科隆 Gamescom 2011 现场，今天是展会的第一天。

cues.en: We've got some of the world's best teams here in Dota. And they're handing out a tournament prize of $1.6 million. It is massive here. A tournament of $1.6 million. That's the future of gaming. This is awesome. It's the first time we're going to see teams of this caliber assembled in one location. These guys are not just nameless faces. They're the best in the world.
cues.zh: 这里汇聚了全球最顶尖的 Dota 战队。他们将争夺高达 160 万美元的赛事总奖金。现场规模极其宏大。一场 160 万美元的锦标赛，这就是游戏的未来。太震撼了。这是我们第一次看到如此高水准的战队齐聚一堂。这些人绝非无名之辈，他们就是世界最强。

cues.en: The bunch of teams we have here, there's a few teams that have individual skill that's unbelievable. And then there's a big group of other teams that have good individual skill, not top-notch, but who win through good strategy and team play. Fier is a great player, for example, but he is not comparable to good players in Asia. And that's nothing against Fier, because he's still an excellent player, but he's not them.
cues.zh: 我们这里的这些战队，有几支的个人技术强得不可思议。还有很大一部分队伍个人实力不错，虽不算顶尖，但靠着优秀的战术和团队协作赢下比赛。比如 Fier 是名很棒的选手，但他确实没法和亚洲的顶尖选手相比。这绝不是针对 Fier，他依然非常出色，但他确实还达不到那个水平。

cues.en: Over in Asia, they take gaming so much more seriously. Just to give you an example, the Korean football team were playing in the World Cup to motivate the Korean football team to play better. They brought in Starcraft brood war professional gamers into the locker room before they ran out so that they got to meet what were their heroes. In China, Dota is to the people there what Starcraft is to Korea.
cues.zh: 在亚洲，他们对待电竞要认真得多。举个例子，韩国足球队征战世界杯时，为了激励队员们发挥得更好，他们在赛前把 Starcraft Brood War 的职业选手请进了更衣室，让球员们见到了自己的偶像。而在中国，Dota 对当地人的意义，就像 Starcraft 对韩国一样。

cues.en: It's televised. The girls like their boyfriends to be Dota players. After a game where they're walking around, you can see fans running up to them, asking them to sign on their shirts. It's like a real sport. The third time I was in China, I was playing with fans for two days. They made a video of me filming me walking in some mountains and I had to say some sentences and stuff. And I was like, yeah, in Dota there's always a new mountain to climb. Stuff like this, you know, and...
cues.zh: 比赛是有电视转播的。女孩子们都喜欢找玩 Dota 的男朋友。赛后走在路上，你能看到粉丝跑过来求在衣服上签名。它就像一项真正的传统体育。我第三次去中国时，跟粉丝们一起打了两天比赛。他们还给我拍了个片子，录我在山里走，我还得说几句台词什么的。我当时就说了句：“是啊，在 Dota 里永远都有新的高山要去攀登。”诸如此类的话，你懂的，然后……

cues.en: I walked up and down these stairs and started running and lifting some weights and just to compare this with Dota like some meta 4 stuff. I will say that China teams are all great. Every player in the team is strong.
cues.zh: 我在这些楼梯上上下下，还开始跑步、举重，就是想拿这个和 Dota 里 meta 4 那类东西作比较。我得说，中国战队都很强。队里每个选手都很强。

cues.en: You don't recognise China players as a player. You just recognise them as a whole team. You just fear the whole team. The Chinese teams that have come to this competition are scaring the shit out of everyone else. We had two of the top Chinese teams in our group. On the Kingdom, it's not been regarded as one of the favourites to win it. In fact, I would consider bottom four or just bottom eight for sure.
cues.zh: 你不会把中国选手当成单个选手来看。你只会把他们当成一整支队伍来看。你就是怕整支队伍。来参加这次比赛的中国战队把其他人都吓尿了。我们组里有两支顶尖中国战队。至于 Kingdom，它一直不被视为夺冠热门。事实上，我肯定会把它排在倒数四名，或者至少倒数八名。

cues.en: This is our first time on LAN together. The team together has only been around for around four to five months, so it's a relatively new team. And Mike at our newest position playing carry for us, he's only been on the team for three weeks now, actually. We were really nervous going against the Chinese team, especially the top Chinese teams. There's going to be players that choke handling this kind of pressure at such a young age. 1437, this is the first time he's ever been on LAN.
cues.zh: 这是我们第一次一起打线下赛。这支队伍组建才四五个月左右，所以算是一支比较新的队伍。而我们最新加入、打 carry 的 Mike，其实进队才三周。我们对上中国战队时真的很紧张，尤其是顶尖中国战队。这么年轻就要承受这种压力，肯定会有选手掉链子。1437，这是他第一次打线下赛。

cues.en: It's not easy like this is a million dollar tournament first time he's been on land this stage the surprise money this prestige This is real competition You try to keep our cool together, and we just played our game Super hyped everyone was surprised. They were doing so good even we couldn't believe it online Kingdom dominating right now
cues.zh: 这不容易，这是百万美元级别的赛事，他第一次登上线下赛舞台，还有奖金、声望……这是真正的竞争。我们努力一起保持冷静，就打自己的比赛。大家都超级兴奋，每个人都很惊讶。他们打得太好了，连我们自己都不敢相信。线上的 Kingdom 现在完全统治了比赛。

cues.en: After the match against Tyloo, everyone was very excited, you know. We just beat one of the teams that were actually favored to win the competition, so everyone's, like, spirits were like, oh, we may be able to actually do this, you know. Eating the Chinese teams, some people just, you know, for fun, they started, okay, hey, it's okay, Nirvana, and they're the China Slayers. If you were a little bit surprised as we had yesterday, quite a few upsets. Okay, Nirvana International managed to beat two Chinese teams in a row.
cues.zh: 对阵 Tyloo 之后，大家都很兴奋。我们刚刚击败了一支本来被看好夺冠的队伍，所以大家士气高涨，觉得：哦，我们也许真能做到。在吃掉中国战队之后，有些人就是图个乐，开始说：行吧，嘿，没问题，Nirvana，他们就是 China Slayers。如果你有点惊讶，就像我们昨天那样，那确实有不少冷门。好吧，Nirvana International 连续击败了两支中国战队。

cues.en: beating out Taidu and Morkay Nirvana's Cien. They're currently on the roll now, and the Chinese teams are not unbeatable. But on the other hand, E-Home has proven that they have been the strongest out of the four Chinese teams, having a clean 3-0 record. They are the favourites to win the whole tournament, so they come in with the confidence that they've won seven championships already. It's always a little bit of a national pride at stake, so of course they want to prove that Chinese owners are a little bit above the rest.
cues.zh: 击败了 Taidu 和 Morkay Nirvana 的 Cien。他们目前正势头正盛，而中国队也并非不可战胜。不过另一方面，E-Home 已经证明了自己是四支中国队中最强的，拿下了干净利落的 3 胜 0 负。他们是最被看好赢得整个赛事的队伍，因此带着已经赢得七座冠军的自信参赛。毕竟这多少也关乎民族荣誉，所以他们当然想证明中国选手确实比其他人高出一筹。

cues.en: Yihong is one of the oldest Chinese Dota organizations. They've always been at the top of competitive gaming, most memorable doing ESWC 2010. Before ESWC 2010, I thought, like, yeah, okay, the Chinese, they're probably pretty good, but, like, how good can they be? And then we played Yihong who won the tournament without losing a single match. Like, they just crushed everything. Yihong finished the year as the best team in history of Dota.
cues.zh: Yihong 是中国最老牌的 Dota 组织之一。他们一直处在电竞竞争的顶尖位置，其中最令人难忘的是 ESWC 2010。ESWC 2010 之前，我当时想，嗯，好吧，中国人可能确实很强，但他们到底能有多强？然后我们遇到了 Yihong，而他们在没有输掉任何一场比赛的情况下赢得了赛事冠军。他们简直碾压了一切对手。Yihong 以 Dota 历史上最强战队的身份结束了这一年。

cues.en: They were just on a totally different level. They had their manager sitting behind them. He was making their calls. He was running around with this little black book and they were the first team I heard of who did that. The E-Home manager copying down the draft, doing the prep work. He was their coach. There was a great interview that was done and it lined up all the top European captains who attended and the topic was E-Home.
cues.zh: 他们完全处于另一个层级。他们的经理就坐在他们身后，负责指挥。他拿着一本小黑册子到处走，而据我所知，他们是第一支这么做的队伍。E-Home 的经理会记下选人和禁用，负责赛前准备。他就是他们的教练。当时有一场很棒的采访，把所有参加赛事的顶尖欧洲队长都请到了一起，而主题就是 E-Home。

cues.en: What do you think of the Chinese guys? I never felt this outplayed in my entire life. It's something I would say, like their timing, their design. They're really in control of the game, the whole game. And they keep this control all the time. This is really crazy to see actually.
cues.zh: 你怎么看中国选手？我这辈子从没感觉自己被压制得这么惨。这正是我会说的——他们的时机把握、他们的战术设计。他们真的掌控着比赛，整局比赛。而且他们一直保持着这种掌控。实际看到真的很震撼。

cues.en: During this trip to the International, it's actually the same period as my exam periods. So I treated it as a sacrifice that I have to make for the team and for myself. And I find that when it comes to pursuing your passions, it's really up to you to decide if it's worth the sacrifice.
cues.zh: 这次来打国际邀请赛，正好和我的考试周撞在一起。所以我把它当成我必须为队伍、也为我自己做出的牺牲。我发现，追求自己热爱的事时，值不值得牺牲，真的由你自己决定。

cues.en: When they were having an asthma, they did not allow him to leave the school. So I told him already, I said, mind yourself. Setting up a career in gaming is risky. It's very risky. Because the examinations actually clash with the competition and missing the exams without a proper explanation, the school didn't recognise the Dota competition as a valid reason. It's kind of breaking school rules. The school is very determined to stop him from pursuing his child's job.
cues.zh: 他哮喘发作的时候，他们不让他离开学校。所以我早就跟他说过，我说，你自己想清楚。在电竞行业立足是有风险的，风险非常大。因为考试正好和比赛冲突，缺考又没有正当解释，学校不认可 Dota 比赛是有效理由。这算是违反校规。学校非常坚决地要阻止他从事自己选择的职业。

cues.en: going for this contest. So I think this has created a big stress for the family. This mother is very hated, you know? It's quite difficult for us to pull him out right now, I think. You know, he's so adamant about it. So that's why when he told me he's going to August, I said, then how about your school at Zen? What are you going to do? I think my mother, she was kind of at her limits, telling me about...
cues.zh: 去参加这个比赛。所以我觉得这给家里带来了很大压力。这位母亲很招人恨，你知道吗？我觉得现在我们很难把他拉出来。你知道，他太坚持了。所以当他告诉我他八月要去时，我说，那你在 Zen 的学业怎么办？你打算怎么办？我觉得我妈妈在跟我说这些的时候，已经有点撑不住了……

cues.en: how much gaming has been weighing me down. No, it was really the talk where I really opened my heart and I should reflect my passion for the game and how much I believe that. My team actually has the potential to win, to be the best in the world. So, we are stopping at nothing less than the first. This is how I try to put it across my mind. By giving up so much to come here, I have absolute confidence in my team that we will win.
cues.zh: 打游戏到底让我多沉重。不，真正让我敞开心扉的，是那次演讲，我应该反思自己对这款游戏的热爱，以及我有多坚信这一点。我的队伍确实有潜力赢，成为世界最强。所以，我们不止步于第一。这就是我试着说服自己想法的方式。放弃这么多来到这里，我对我队伍有绝对的信心，我们会赢。

cues.en: Drafting is where two captains will select what they want to play with. What heroes are selected and what heroes are taken in. You can select five heroes out of a pool of over a hundred.
cues.zh: 选人环节是两位队长挑选各自想玩的英雄。选哪些英雄，禁哪些英雄。你可以从一百多个英雄的池子里选五个。

cues.en: and can also remove four of those heroes. So four heroes you think your opponent will want to use, you can remove. Before any game, any match, we would decide our band and picks according to which team we are fighting. Usually we would come up with a very impromptu strategy to try and fight that you really have to spend a lot of time thinking of the draft. The draft only decides a lot of the game itself. He hoped they're a team with so much experience.
cues.zh: 还能禁掉其中四个英雄。你觉得对手想用的四个英雄，你可以禁掉。在任何一场比赛前，我们会根据对手是谁来决定禁选。通常我们会临时想出一套策略来应对，真的得花很多时间琢磨选人。选人本身就很大程度上决定了比赛走向。他希望他们是一支经验丰富的队伍。

cues.en: They already know the way they want to roll this one out. The only thing that's really going to make it or break it for them is if they can get their execution right. In that particular match-up, we felt that we needed something that could instill the fear in them. And Tiny looks to be the last pickup here from Sion. Bit of an interesting pickup there, but Sion's going to start to change around the lanes completely now. With Tiny, it is good as a surprise strat. If another team doesn't realize where he fits into the whole lineup.
cues.zh: 他们早就清楚自己想怎么打这一局。真正决定他们成败的，只有能否把执行做到位。在那场对局里，我们觉得需要一些能让他们心生恐惧的东西。Tiny看起来是Sion这边的最后一手。这手选得有点意思，但Sion现在要彻底调整分路了。选Tiny，作为奇招很不错。如果另一支队伍没搞清他在整个阵容里的定位。

cues.en: then you can really throw the opposition off balance. You have such a huge audience and you know that everyone is at home watching the game. They have their hopes been on you and I feel that there's so much at stake.
cues.zh: 这样你就能彻底打乱对手的节奏。台下有这么庞大的观众群，而且你知道所有人都在家里看比赛。他们把希望都寄托在你身上，我觉得这背负的实在太多了。

cues.en: And they should be able to clean it up right now. Tiny is going to toss, he's going to launch, and he definitely gets the kill. We've got 3.57 getting nailed out there. They just broke it, they're going to get the last hit as well. There's the entire team down for E-hope. This is GG. This is now a double-rack. At E-hope, they're going to disconnect. We have our first winner's bracket finalist. Scythe will advance. E-hope will drop down into the loser's bracket. And Scythe will now finish up this game.
cues.zh: 他们现在应该能收割残局了。Tiny要扔了，直接丢过去，稳稳拿下人头。3.57在那边被击杀了。他们刚破掉高地，最后一击也收入囊中。E-hope全员阵亡。打出GG了。现在是两路告破。E-hope这边，他们准备退游戏了。我们的第一支胜者组决赛队伍诞生了。Scythe成功晋级。E-hope掉入败者组。Scythe现在要终结这场比赛了。

cues.en: Yeah, the one million is... Yeah, one million. That's a lot. Geez. Gonna make my time playing this game all with it. Didn't think smoking would do me any good. Yeah. When did you start smoking? Two years back. Two years back.
cues.zh: 是啊，那一百万……对，一百万。真是一大笔钱。天呐。这让我玩这游戏付出的时间全都值了。没想过抽烟能有什么好处。是啊。你什么时候开始抽烟的？两年前。两年前。

cues.en: Bad move. On bad terms. Seems like she's moved on already. Back then when she was playing the game, it felt like we had something to, something we shared. But you know, it's like, I think she's, I think she's following this event, but probably this event's big. We get the main phone call.
cues.zh: 走错了一步。不欢而散。看来她已经走出来了。以前她也玩这游戏的时候，感觉我们还有共同话题，有些能一起分享的东西。但你知道，感觉就像是……我觉得她应该在关注这次赛事，可能主要是因为这次比赛规模太大了。我们接到了那通最重要的电话。

cues.en: Finally, I have something I'm proud of to tell about, finally. When you played the Russians and the Ukrainians, they were just the unpredictable teams. I had no idea what the Russians were thinking. That was their best weapon. We're having fun. We're trying to relax. We're trying to scare our opponent. Mind games. Mind games. I turn off my brain in the way of being scary of someone.
cues.zh: 终于，我终于有件能让自己骄傲的事可以说说了。当你跟俄罗斯和乌克兰的队伍交手时，他们完全让人捉摸不透。我根本不知道那些俄罗斯人在想什么。那就是他们最厉害的武器。我们玩得很开心。我们尽量放松。我们试着去震慑对手。心理战。心理战。至于害怕对手这种情绪，我直接把大脑放空，根本不去想。

cues.en: One of the things I really admire about him is how he hasn't really had an easy life, but he's always so upbeat. He's always so cheerful. When he first came on the notice scene, he looked like a 12-year-old boy. Errol was just like, who is this kid? There's no way you could take this guy seriously. And then he would destroy you in games.
cues.zh: 他有一点让我特别佩服：他的生活其实并不轻松，但他总是那么乐观，总是那么开朗。他刚进入大家视野时，看起来就像个12岁的小孩。Errol 当时就想，这孩子是谁啊？你根本没法把他当回事。然后他会在游戏里把你打爆。

cues.en: He can make really good moves. His moves, I think, are unique, and they might win you the game. But he wants to rely completely on skill. He wants, like, an enemy against him, and he wants to kill him through skill, nothing more. He wants to win the game. His disadvantage is that he doesn't have patience. He wants to make those moves.
cues.zh: 他能打出非常漂亮的操。我觉得他的操作很独特，而且可能帮你赢下比赛。但他想完全靠技术取胜。他想要有个对手，然后靠技术把对方击杀，仅此而已。他想赢下比赛。他的缺点是没耐心。他就想打出那些操作。

cues.en: He can get a little bit too silly in games. He will try new and different things. He will overextend in team fights because he believes he can get the kill. And his impatience can go too far and he might lose the game for us.
cues.zh: 他在游戏里有时会太胡闹。他会尝试新的、不同的东西。团战里他会过于冒进，因为他觉得自己能拿到击杀。他的急躁可能过头，然后让我们输掉比赛。

cues.en: Most teams that you see that have the most fan bases are full nationality. Our team is all spread out across the world. He does have it a little harder than us.
cues.zh: 你看到的大多数粉丝最多的队伍，都是全本土阵容。我们队则分散在世界各地。他的处境确实比我们更难一点。

cues.en: because he doesn't really have this human support that we do. The hardest thing I had to really deal with in my life is just trying to convince my family about my gaming career. It's really, really difficult, especially when you start out slow, but you know there's a future for something and you put a lot of time in and they keep telling you, like, you should probably get a real job. I was born in the Los Angeles district in Lancaster, California. I lived there with my dad and my mom.
cues.zh: 因为他没有我们这种身边人的支持。我人生中真正最难处理的事，就是努力说服家人接受我的电竞职业。这真的真的很难，尤其是起步慢的时候，但你知道某件事是有前途的，你投入了大量时间，他们却一直跟你说，你大概该去找份正经工作。我出生在加州兰卡斯特的洛杉矶地区。我和我爸我妈住在那儿。

cues.en: Around two years old, my dad left my mom. He didn't really say anything. He just kind of, he just packed up and left. She's had to raise us both while going to law school at the same time. It wasn't real easy as far as just got out of law school, didn't have a job, had huge student loans to pay back. This job came up and so we moved here on our own. So I've been raising them by myself ever since. So this...
cues.zh: 我大约两岁的时候，爸爸离开了妈妈。他什么也没说，就这样收拾行李走了。妈妈不得不一边上法学院，一边独自抚养我们兄弟俩。刚从法学院毕业，没有工作，还要还巨额的助学贷款，日子实在不容易。后来有了这么一个工作机会，我们就自己搬到了这里。从那以后，一直都是我一个人带他们。所以这个……

cues.en: is the photo album that I made for Clinton for as he was growing up. I put pictures in it as we went along. My sons were both really active into sports and they wanted to do a lot, so I had to limit them. They could choose two per season. That was maximum for me being able to get them to practice and go watch their games. That was tough. And Clinton sent in on Santa's lap, his brother Santa.
cues.zh: 这是我给克林顿做的一本相册，记录他成长的过程，一路把照片放进去。我两个儿子都非常好动，喜欢运动，什么都想参加，所以我只能限制他们，每个赛季最多只能选两项。因为我要送他们去训练、还要去看比赛，这已经是我的极限了。真的挺不容易。这张是克林顿坐在圣诞老人腿上，他哥哥和圣诞老人……

cues.en: My brother is more angry at my father for leaving than I am. He thinks about him, he gets upset. Compared to me, I just block him out and pretend it doesn't exist. Clinton already starting video games here. He was sitting at his house playing Dota, doing it competitively, had a sponsor team and everything like that. But I think that's when it probably started getting on his mom's nerves. I have a crazy sleeping schedule.
cues.zh: 比起我，我哥哥对爸爸的离开更生气。他一想起爸爸就会难受。而我不一样，我直接把爸爸从脑海里排除掉，假装这个人不存在。克林顿这时候已经开始打电子游戏了。他坐在家里玩 Dota，打得很专业，还有赞助战队之类的。不过我觉得，大概就是从那时候起，他妈开始受不了了。我的作息时间特别混乱。

cues.en: I'm on a European team, so sometimes I have to stay up at pretty ridiculous hours or wake up at ridiculous hours. So the standard day for me is not so standard. All the nights he'd be up, except that the dog would be up too with him, and that would keep her awake most of the nights, and this is kind of where the tension got pretty high. You know, this went on for years, and it came to the point where I just told him, I said, you know what, you just need to go somewhere else. So...
cues.zh: 我在一支欧洲战队，所以有时候得熬夜到离谱的时间，或者起得特别早。对我来说，所谓的"标准的一天"一点都不标准。他每天晚上都熬夜，狗也陪着他一起醒着，结果吵得她好多晚上都睡不好，家里的紧张气氛就是这么越来越重的。这种日子持续了好多年，最后我直接跟他说：听着，你还是搬出去住吧。于是……

cues.en: I got kicked out of my house because of my gaming career, basically. When Clinton first moved in here, he was looking for a desk, and there wasn't anything in the room, and I have a lot of stuff that we're getting ready to take to the dump. And Clinton went out there, and he came back in with this green desk, and he goes, this is perfect!
cues.zh: 基本上，我因为打职业被家里赶了出来。Clinton 刚搬来时想找张桌子，房间里空空如也，我正好有一堆东西正准备扔去垃圾场。Clinton 跑过去看，搬回来这张绿色的桌子，还说：这太完美了！

cues.en: so I didn't have a monitor so I went to my friend and he had a spare CRT monitor so I got that and then obviously I have two books here to hunch that up so I can actually see the monitor so it's kind of a ghetto setup even when I go to competitions so I don't think I play like any differently on the nice setups compared to this one. Clinton's like the rocky Balboa of Dota. He's definitely one of the first big US players and I honestly didn't even know he was that big.
cues.zh: 当时我没有显示器，就去找朋友，他刚好有一台闲置的 CRT 显示器，我就借来了。很明显，我在这下面垫了两本书架高，这样才能正视屏幕。这套设备确实挺简陋的。不过就算去打比赛，我觉得自己在那些好设备上的表现，跟在这台破电脑前也没什么两样。Clinton 就像 Dota 界的 Rocky Balboa。他绝对是美国最早成名的顶尖选手之一，老实说我以前甚至都不知道他名头这么大。

cues.en: In the North American scene, there weren't many good American players known back then. Everybody respected fear. A lot of the people I knew, they quit the game, they moved on, stuff like that, but I stuck with it, so I ended up being one of the oldest players. With all of his years of experience and all of his constant commitment to the game, he's really shown that he doesn't give up. Growing up without my father, I think, in the end, not having someone there to teach me the guy side.
cues.zh: 在当年的北美圈子里，出名的美国优秀选手并不多。但所有人都敬佩 Fear。我认识的很多人后来都不打了，各奔前程，但我坚持了下来，不知不觉就成了资历最老的选手之一。凭借这么多年的经验以及对比赛从未间断的投入，他切实展现了什么叫决不放弃。在没有父亲的环境中长大，我觉得，最终还是缺了那么一个教我如何成长为男子汉的人。

cues.en: Having a father to help you up, I think that has actually probably made me like the person I am today. You know, I just make sure everything is running smoothly on the team. I kind of play like the father figure, I guess. As a captain, I guess he felt he had that responsibility as well. He was like pretty much my mentor. He did tell me one time, like, if you need someone to talk to, you know, he would be here. So I kind of see him as a dota brother. I've never had an ego like thinking I'm better than anyone else. I'm always there willing to help people who are new to the scene.
cues.zh: 有个父亲般的人拉你一把，我觉得这大概也造就了今天的我。你知道，我就是确保队里一切运转顺利。我有点像父亲角色吧。作为队长，我觉得他也觉得自己有那份责任。他几乎就是我的导师。他有一次跟我说，如果你需要找人聊聊，他会在。所以我有点把他看作 Dota 兄弟。我从没自大到觉得自己比别人强。我总是愿意帮助刚入行的人。

cues.en: And that's always been kind of my role in the game, just helping players get up for the most part. Fear actually broke me into the scene. You know, it's very hard to get yourself out there. I mean, back then, I was kind of like a fanboy of him, you know, watching his games and whatnot. And he gave me a shot to play at a high level. I wouldn't be here today if it wasn't for fear. I can guarantee you that.
cues.zh: 这也一直是我在游戏里的角色，大多数时候就是帮助选手成长。其实是 Fear 把我带进这个圈子的。你知道，想让自己出头很难。当时我有点像他的粉丝，会看他的比赛什么的。他给了我打高水平比赛的机会。要不是 Fear，我今天不会在这里。这点我可以保证。

cues.en: Going into the match, we were all thinking M.U.F.C. didn't do so well earlier, but... If people lost that game, we wouldn't win anything, so it was a high-risk game. 36 minutes in, almost a 7,000 gold advantage in favor of M.U.F.C. According to the end of the game, we made a couple of mistakes that put two girls on the sideline for us, and they had all five still up and decided that they were going to go for a throne.
cues.zh: 进入比赛时，我们都觉得 M.U.F.C. 之前打得不太好，但是……如果那场输了，我们就什么都赢不了，所以是高风险比赛。36 分钟时，M.U.F.C. 领先近 7000 经济。比赛后期，我们犯了几个错误，让我们这边两个姑娘只能在场边，而他们五个人都还在，决定直接去推王座。

cues.en: We were really close to losing our throne. It's the low 20% HP. At Online Kingdom, they are so close to the point of getting eliminated from this tournament. We just needed to do something. I ran in first, and then they all went on me, and so they were focusing on the throne, which was good. I can't buy silver cross fear. He's trying to retreat. He turns into a pig. And how the hell is he still alive?
cues.zh: 我们差点就丢掉王座了。血量只剩两成出头。在Online Kingdom这边，他们眼看就要被淘汰出这届锦标赛了。我们必须做点什么。我先冲了进去，然后他们全扑向我，所以他们的注意力都放在王座上，这很好。我没法买银十字畏惧。他想撤退。他变成了猪。他到底怎么还活着的？

cues.en: We made this huge comeback where we killed all of the heroes, they now started pushing. Our whole team.
cues.zh: 我们打出了这波大翻盘，把他们的英雄全杀了，他们现在开始推进了。我们全队。

cues.en: Just went crazy. This is Keche. We are 2008 ESWC winners. One of the best Asian teams, but we don't afraid them. We're going to fight them. I don't know about my teammates, but I don't feel scary at all.
cues.zh: 简直打疯了。我是Keche。我们是2008年ESWC冠军。亚洲最强战队之一，但我们不怕他们。我们要跟他们打。我不知道队友怎么想，但我一点都不觉得害怕。

cues.en: I feel like I want to crush my enemy. That's how I feel. That's it. Welcome to the winner's bracket final, where Scythe goes up against Navi. The winner gets a slot in the grand final. The crowd's watching for them and their draft was very scary. We were like caught off by surprise. But we were like, we got to win this, man. We got to win this and show them who's boss. Scythe have managed to take all the best players from Singapore and put them in their lineup.
cues.zh: 我感觉我想碾碎我的敌人。这就是我的感觉。就这样。欢迎来到胜者组决赛，由Scythe对阵Navi。胜者将获得总决赛席位。观众都在关注他们，而他们的阵容选得非常吓人。我们有点被打了个措手不及。但我们想，这场我们必须赢，兄弟。我们必须赢下这场，让他们知道谁才是老大。Scythe成功把新加坡所有最好的选手都招进了阵容。

cues.en: You know, Na'Vi, they look cool, calm, and collective. They know exactly what they gotta do. It all comes down to gameplay right now, and I gotta say, like Na'Vi's lineup, it is not unbeatable. So now they get a look at the initiation, and possible kill, HY is gonna get caught. Now bottom lane, held in place, Sven's done. No, Sven will go down near Light of Heaven, he's helping out, but then he gets the last hit. Na'Vi and dominating this final!
cues.zh: 你知道，Na'Vi看起来冷静、沉着、团结。他们很清楚自己该做什么。现在一切都要看场上发挥了，我得说，Na'Vi的阵容并非不可战胜。现在他们看到了先手机会，可能拿到击杀，HY要被抓住了。现在下路，被定在原地，Sven完了。不，Sven会在Light of Heaven附近倒下，他在支援，但随后他拿到了最后一击。Na'Vi正在统治这场决赛！

cues.en: We've just lost our confidence match against Navi. It was actually quite a blow to us. The game was really the turning point for me. Because...
cues.zh: 我们刚刚输掉了对阵 Navi 的信心赛，这对我们打击很大。那场比赛对我来说真的是一个转折点。因为……

cues.en: I actually learned that in life, you can only trust yourself actually. Not in the sense that you can't trust people. But, yeah, like I said, the ones who will never let you down is yourself. Within the gaming world, I'd like to be the first place. You know, it's like I'm following him behind my mother's footstep, basically. She worked really hard to get where she is. And I kind of want to be the same way. I want to work hard for whatever I do. For me, I mean, I've never really had a dad, so if I had any questions about anything, the person I was most comfortable talking to was my mom.
cues.zh: 我后来才明白，在人生中，你其实只能相信自己。当然，这不是说你不能相信别人。但就像我说的，永远不会让你失望的人就是自己。在游戏领域，我想做到第一。你知道，我基本上是在追随我母亲的脚步。她非常努力，才走到今天的位置。我也想成为这样的人，无论做什么，我都想努力去做好。对我来说，我从来没有真正拥有过父亲，所以不管遇到什么问题，我最愿意倾诉的人就是我妈妈。

cues.en: She definitely had the most influence on my life. When she comes home from work, she's always anxious to bring up the subject, how she won a big case. I'm always proud of her when she wins these big cases, because I know it means a lot to her. In the back of my head, I'm always like, if I do well and if I win this tournament, I'll finally be able to prove I'm getting something out of this. And whoever wins this match will be facing up against E-Home, but whoever will lose it...
cues.zh: 她绝对是对我人生影响最大的人。下班回家后，她总迫不及待地提起自己如何赢下一桩大案子。每次她赢下这些大案子，我都为她骄傲，因为我知道这对她意义重大。我心里一直想着，如果我表现出色、如果我赢下这届比赛，我终于能证明自己从中有所收获。而这场比赛赢的人将对阵 E-Home，输的人……

cues.en: We had the stronger lake in here, it's the better team fight. Just all we had to do was just control the pushes. We were so close to winning until some few mistakes.
cues.zh: 我们这边的优势路更强，团战也更好打。我们只需要控制好推进就行。离胜利已经很近了，却因为几次失误功亏一篑。

cues.en: That occurred in the late game. It's communication at alms because we're an international team, so I think the full nationality teams have an advantage over most teams. They just slowly beat us down.
cues.zh: 那是在比赛后期发生的。因为我们是一支国际战队，沟通存在障碍，所以我觉得全员同国籍的队伍比大多数战队更有优势。他们就这样一点点把我们蚕食击垮了。

cues.en: Eventually, they just broke her base and took off every single one of her Raxes.
cues.zh: 最后，他们直接推平了基地，拆光了所有的兵营。

cues.en: I think everybody on the team was very emotional. I could only imagine how he was feeling. Some people take it more personally and they give everything to win. It was very satisfying knowing that we reached that top hit, but he had better expectations for our team and we'd come a long way and it's all thanks to fear. Go as far as you thought you were going to be. I guess you end up in tears or something.
cues.zh: 我觉得队里的每个人情绪都很激动。我完全能体会他当时的感受。有些人把输赢看得更重，为了胜利倾尽所有。能打进前列固然很让人欣慰，但他对队伍有着更高的期望，而且我们一路走来多亏了 Fear。如果没能走到预想的高度，换做是谁最后大概都会掉眼泪吧。

cues.en: All of a sudden, I'm really disappointed, but I guess that's just how it goes. When I get back home, I need to make a big decision in my life, like just the benefits of playing Dota professionally, how much I can make from it, and how much time I really need to put in it to be 100%. So the only way I would ever do that is if I move in with my teammates and have like a training house with them. So I know for sure we're all dedicated. I think things happen for a reason.
cues.zh: 突然之间，我感到非常失望，但现实就是这样。等我回到家，就必须做个人生重大决定了，得权衡打职业 Dota 的得失、能赚多少钱，以及要做到全力以赴究竟得投入多少时间。所以我继续打下去的唯一办法，就是搬去和队友一起住训练基地。这样我才能确信大家都是全心投入的。我觉得一切事情的发生都有其原因。

cues.en: When things happen, you just do your best and continue going forward with it. I mean, deep down inside, I know this career is going to work out for me in the end.
cues.zh: 事情既然发生了，那就全力以赴，继续往前走。说真的，在内心深处，我知道走这条职业道路最终一定能成功。

cues.en: They need to get this kill this time. The Weaver waits, it's a little piglet, and it's dead. Slice! H2O, he's almost dead. Burrow strike! F.E.S.S.T.A. 357. It's a double kill by the Weaver. He heard they'll lose F.E.S.T.P. as well. Moscow 5, casualties of war. Holy hell!
cues.zh: 这次他们必须拿下这个人头。Weaver在等，一个小猪，已经死了。Slice！H2O，他快死了。掘地穿刺！F.E.S.S.T.A. 357。Weaver拿下双杀。听说他们也要丢掉F.E.S.T.P.。Moscow 5，战争伤亡。我的天！

cues.en: I think it's going to be a lot of fun. I think it's going to be a lot of fun. I think it's going to be a lot of fun. I think it's going to be a lot of fun.
cues.zh: 我觉得这会特别有意思。我觉得这会特别有意思。我觉得这会特别有意思。我觉得这会特别有意思。

cues.en: I think it's going to be the best thing for me to do. I think it's going to be the best thing for me to do.
cues.zh: 我觉得这对我来说会是最好的选择。我觉得这对我来说会是最好的选择。

cues.en: This is where my dad works for as long as I remember, man. He's doing the logistics for the company here. So he involves the shipping of the containers from one place to another. When I was younger, he used to work like 15 to 16 hours a day.
cues.zh: 从我记事起，我爸就在这儿上班，老兄。他在这家公司做物流。所以他要管集装箱从一个地方运到另一个地方。我小时候，他每天要干15到16个小时。

cues.en: He's pretty much given up on everything else in his life. It's always made it clear to me that I should focus on my life, focus on my studies so as to not follow these footsteps. He doesn't want me to be slogging as hard as he is right now. But the chance to be the best in the world at something, you don't get it much in life.
cues.zh: 他几乎放弃了生活里的其他一切。他一直明确告诉我，要专注自己的生活，专注学业，别走他的老路。他不想我像他现在这样拼命苦干。但有机会成为世界上某个领域最强的人，人生中可不多见。

cues.en: It's disappointing. Never go to school, you want to play computer. Then morning, it's late. Then computer, until the next day, morning, then it's late. The whole day, at least 15 hours, I computer that. It's a lie. My son's love is like that. For me, I host my son to study more. Don't let me never study. When I'm younger, I also say, always spend a lot of time to play.
cues.zh: 很失望。不去上学，只想玩电脑。早上起得晚。然后玩电脑到第二天早上，又起得晚。一整天至少15个小时都泡在电脑上。这是瞎说。我儿子就爱这样。对我来说，我支持儿子多学习。别像我一样不学习。我年轻时也总说，要多花时间玩。

cues.en: The other night, I was a regret. I didn't study. But now, I hope my son continues to study education better than me. It's my hope. I think it was a great choice, a brilliant choice, because he was confident that we could win. It was an opportunity that you shouldn't miss out. So, get ready, sign in, log in, play around, test a little bit, and then join the lobby in about four minutes. It's once in a lifetime chance. If you miss it, it might be gone forever. You might not experience it again.
cues.zh: 那天晚上，我很后悔自己没好好学习。但现在，我希望儿子能继续求学，比我学得更好。这是我的心愿。我觉得这是个很棒的选择，简直太明智了，因为他相信我们能赢。这是个不容错过的机会。所以，准备好，注册、登录，先玩一会儿，稍微测试一下，然后大约四分钟后进入大厅。这是千载难逢的机会。错过了，可能就永远没有了。你可能再也体验不到。

cues.en: And we have a rematch. E-Home versus Sion, E-Home facing up against a team who forced them into the lower bracket. The psychological pressure is immense, especially upon the drafter, because he is the one who is in the end responsible for the team's picks.
cues.zh: 我们迎来了复赛。E-Home 对阵 Sion。E-Home 将再次面对那支曾把他们打入败者组的队伍。心理压力非常大，尤其是选手的压力，因为最终要为全队选人负责的就是他。

cues.en: Shadow Fiend? Oh, righty. Then it's HY, HY is SF. Everyone knows how to counter a Shadow Fiend. It's a very bold pick-up here by SIDE. The fact that if SIDE win the early game, they're going to gain so much momentum that if they don't, then E-Home will basically roll themselves into the grand final.
cues.zh: 影魔？哦，对。那就是 HY，HY 操刀影魔。谁都知道怎么克制影魔。SIDE 这一手选得非常大胆。如果 SIDE 赢下前期，就能积累巨大的优势；如果没赢，E-Home 基本就会一路挺进总决赛。

cues.en: H1, H1, BKB is going to wear off pretty soon and Venom is a great strike. H1 did. And he wants X, Y, catches up to him and he brings him down. He cogs. Joey, he wants to leave, but there's just no manner. He gets to jump out.
cues.zh: H1，H1，黑皇杖效果很快就要结束了，剧毒术士是个很好的突破口。H1 做到了。他想找 X，Y 追上他并将他击倒。他放出了齿轮。Joey 想撤退，但根本无路可走。他跳了出去。

cues.en: If he can pop off an ulti like that, he doesn't really have to reveal himself to his opponent. He can really just initiate. Oh, there he goes! H1H1 just managed to pop off an ulti, but Earthshaker is already dead! H2O ruling gunning for H1H1! They're already three gone! Make that four! There's a double kill for the anti-mades! And they're headed for the tower right now! There is a GG! Good game called by H1H1! Siden have had enough now! Eho will advance! The Chinese words will stay alive as they will go on!
cues.zh: 如果他能放出这样的终极技能，就不必在对手面前暴露自己，完全可以直接先手。哦，他出手了！H1H1 刚放出终极技能，但撼地者已经阵亡！H2O 正火力全开，追击 H1H1！他们已经倒下三人！现在是四人！敌法师拿下双杀！他们正朝防御塔推进！有人喊出了 GG！H1H1 宣布比赛结束！Siden 现在已经撑不住了！Eho 将晋级！中国队伍将继续留在赛场上，向前迈进！

cues.en: The first spacing was very important to me. And to add on to that, my studies were also at the same time affected by everything. So everything was related. When everything comes falling down at the same time, it's quite hard to handle. Things are all changed. So you've got to plan your life again, all over again. I've learned a lot. You've got to realise your flaws. This is the toughest part of you. I don't do things as well alone. So if you try to do everything by yourself,
cues.zh: 间距对我个人来说非常重要。除此之外，我的学业也同时受到了影响，所以一切都是相互关联的。当所有事情同时崩塌时，真的很难应对。一切都变了，你得重新规划自己的人生，从头再来。我学到了很多，你必须正视自己的缺点，这是最难的部分。我一个人做事做不好，所以如果你想凡事都靠自己，

cues.en: It's not going to be possible. I'm actually a believer of fate. I told myself that waiting isn't necessary because there are so many more things in life. How you take care of the people you love. I think that's a very big thing. That's a very important thing. It's the most important thing ever. I just woke up. It's not fair. My haircut is still crazy. No? But I don't care.
cues.zh: 那是不可能的。其实我是个相信命运的人。我告诉自己，没必要一直等待，因为人生中还有更多重要的事情，比如你如何照顾你所爱的人。我觉得这是件很大的事，也是非常重要的事，甚至是最重要的事。我刚睡醒，头发还乱糟糟的，很不像话吧？但我不在乎。

cues.en: We are now at the final day of the international Dota 2 Championships. It is Na'Vi, level 1 game advantage sitting very, very sweetly in the grand final. Who will get a shot at the $1 million? Na'Vi was running the same strategy the whole time and no one seemed to be able to counter it. Na'Vi loves pushing from minute 10 and trying to end the game at minute 15.
cues.zh: 现在是国际 Dota 2 锦标赛的决赛日。Na'Vi 带着一比零的领先优势，非常从容地坐镇总决赛。谁能冲击那 100 万美元的奖金？Na'Vi 一直在使用同一套战术，而且似乎没有人能破解它。Na'Vi 热衷于从第 10 分钟开始推进，试图在第 15 分钟结束比赛。

cues.en: Those strategies are very sensitive because if you fail even once, it can become a very difficult game for you. E-Home has been known for how well they defend their base. So if there was a team that could stop Na'Vi's push, it would be E-Home. And let's get this game underway. The players will start to pick up their heroes with one million dollars at stake. Na'Vi will meet to win two. E-Home will meet to win three. Very, very old school strategy with three core heroes.
cues.zh: 这类战术非常敏感，因为哪怕失败一次，比赛就会变得非常艰难。E-Home 一直以来都以擅长防守基地著称，所以如果说有哪支队伍能挡住 Na'Vi 的推进，那就是 E-Home。让我们开始这场比赛吧。选手们将开始选择英雄，百万美元奖金悬于此战。Na'Vi 需要赢下两局，E-Home 则需要赢下三局。非常老派的战术，选了三个核心英雄。

cues.en: Iho managed to survive Navi's onslaught early. Every time we see Dendy perform, he's always playing very well and he usually doesn't lose his lanes. So Dendy, like his impatience is that Chinese teams, they are patient. They look out for the fact that you might cross the line.
cues.zh: Iho 早期扛住了 Navi 的猛攻。每次看到 Dendy 上场，他都打得非常好，而且通常不会输线。所以 Dendy 的毛病是不耐烦，而中国队伍很有耐心。他们会盯着你可能越线这一点。

cues.en: And they will take you and kill you and win the game through those situations. The way Na'Vi played, they really gambled basically.
cues.zh: 他们会抓住你、杀掉你，并借这些情况赢下比赛。Na'Vi 的打法，基本就是在赌。

cues.en: They take your little upsets and just win the game through those mistakes.
cues.zh: 他们会抓住你的小失误，就靠这些失误赢下比赛。

cues.en: Na'Vi cannot believe it! They've dominated this tournament up till now and E-Home takes the first match so convincingly. That was the first loss of Na'Vi during the whole tournament. They went undefeated until the grand final. We're going to have a 15 minute break and be right back here so Na'Vi may need to compose themselves. E-Home, well, they just need to be awesome. What a play! Any lose actually makes me pretty sad. We try to put the little pictures here.
cues.zh: Na'Vi 简直不敢相信！他们此前一直统治这项赛事，而 E-Home 如此令人信服地拿下第一局。这是 Na'Vi 整届赛事的首败。他们一路不败，直到总决赛。我们会休息 15 分钟，马上回到这里，所以 Na'Vi 可能需要调整心态。E-Home 嘛，他们只需要继续保持出色。打得太漂亮了！其实任何失利都让我挺难过。我们试着把小照片放这里。

cues.en: This is our mom and dad, and I think that this one is our favorite, actually. My childhood, we lived full life, and dad was working for all our lives. But he helped us every time and every problem. I just asked him if he'd do everything for me, for Kata, for Daniel as well. But Daniel's grandfather was like friends.
cues.zh: 这是我们的妈妈和爸爸，我觉得这张其实是我们最喜欢的。我的童年，我们生活得很充实，爸爸一辈子都在工作。但每次遇到问题，他都会帮我们。我问他，是否愿意为我和 Kata、还有 Daniel 做任何事。但 Daniel 的祖父就像朋友一样。

cues.en: They can see with no speaking for hours and just enjoy each other's company.
cues.zh: 他们可以几个小时不说话，只是看着彼此，享受彼此的陪伴。

cues.en: They understood each other without words. One day I was going fishing, but Dad never showed up. When I came home, it's already super late. He was feeling bad. He went to the hospital. He decided to stay for a few weeks, you know, so we watched everything, stuff like this. And cancer. It was a very big shock for me because it was very thin.
cues.zh: 他们无需言语就能理解彼此。有一天我去钓鱼，但爸爸一直没出现。我回家时已经很晚了。他感觉不舒服。他去了医院。他决定住几周，你知道，我们目睹了一切，诸如此类。然后是癌症。这对我打击很大，因为他瘦了很多。

cues.en: I cannot understand this is my father. I was sure that it must be okay, but it's really short time. I was really sad and was crying a lot. I was sad about I couldn't say him many times how much I love him.
cues.zh: 我无法接受这竟然是我父亲。我确信一定会没事，但时间真的很短。我很难过，哭了很多。我难过的是，我没能多告诉他几次我有多爱他。

cues.en: Actually, I spent more time on a computer because I could not think about it. It's like a destructor. It was like a start time actually. The push to play more. And that's maybe one of the reasons why I'm playing now. Maybe I wouldn't play at all. The relationship of Daniel and my mom grew stronger these days. They support each other.
cues.zh: 其实，我更多时间花在电脑上，因为我不愿去想这件事。它就像一个破坏器。其实也像是一个起点。一种推动我打更多游戏的力量。这也许是我现在还在打比赛的原因之一。否则我可能根本不会打。Daniel 和我妈妈的关系这些天变得更亲密了。他们互相支持。

cues.en: And they are very good friends. I think that this is very important for all the new. You know, five years ago I wouldn't care about many things. Now I'm thinking about it a lot. Something knocks you down. You need to learn to get up. So I'm trying to research this, to learn to get up.
cues.zh: 他们是非常好的朋友。我觉得这对所有新来的人来说都很重要。你知道，五年前我不会在意很多事。现在我会想很多。有些东西会把你击倒。你需要学会站起来。所以我试着研究这个，学会站起来。

cues.en: This is the most important moment in my life because everything I worked on wasn't useful and now I have a chance to win this tournament for my family. Because our picks look completely different, we were like passive and stuff. People thought like we lost the first game, we're gonna lose the second game. We were maybe a little bit demoralized.
cues.zh: 这是我人生中最重要的时刻，因为我之前做的一切都没用，现在我有机会为家人赢下这项赛事。因为我们的选人看起来完全不一样，我们有点被动之类的。人们觉得我们输了第一局，就会输第二局。我们可能有点士气低落。

cues.en: We really needed to change to a different pick. We were missing something. It was like, one hero left and I never played it before. Then we're like, Dendi, you go. He's like, guys, I've never played it, but I can do it. So we took the risk of taking him and risking maybe playing him badly.
cues.zh: 我们真的必须换一个选人。我们缺了点什么。就像只剩一个英雄，而我之前从没玩过。然后我们说，Dendi，你上。他说，兄弟们，我从没玩过，但我能行。所以我们就冒了这个险，选了他，也冒着可能打得很差的风险。

cues.en: So it looks like down on that bottom lane, Dendi will be taking the enigma. It is going to be a very, very rough lane. Na'Vi lost the game. They're playing something now that they're not as confident with. E-Home figured out Na'Vi, figured out how to play against it, and so I'm going to stick to my word and I'm going to say E-Home will win it. It was incredibly bold for Dendi to do that on the verge of winning the million dollars for your team.
cues.zh: 看起来下路那边，Dendi 会拿 Enigma。这条线会非常非常难打。Na'Vi 输掉了这局。他们现在玩的东西，自己也没那么有信心。E-Home 摸透了 Na'Vi，知道怎么针对他们打，所以我要坚持我的说法：E-Home 会赢。在即将为队伍赢下百万美元的时候，Dendi 还敢这么做，真的非常大胆。

cues.en: I think it's going to be a lot of fun.
cues.zh: 我觉得这会非常有意思。

cues.en: But I know if I die, I die not for nothing. Sometimes this can be like you dying, but your teammates picking up more.
cues.zh: 但我知道，如果我死了，我不会白死。有时候就像你死了，但队友能拿到更多。

cues.en: They weren't ready for the Indy Enigma. He was a patient in England. I was the most patient in England in the world. That really impresses me how he's able to make that transition. You just have to have the balls basically. He was scared of losing. That's why he was so patient and he did everything right.
cues.zh: 他们没准备好应对 Indy 的 Enigma。他在游戏里很有耐心。我是世界上最有耐心的。他能够完成这种转变，真的很让我佩服。基本上，你就是得有胆量。他怕输。所以他才会那么有耐心，而且每件事都做对了。

cues.en: Their strategy is kind of similar to how E-Home won. Na'Vi defeated them late game, and I think this really shattered E-Home's confidence. And GG is the call from E-Home. Na'Vi, they take the game, and they are only one win short of taking home one million dollars. But the question really is... We hardly won the second game.
cues.zh: 他们的策略和 E-Home 赢的方式有点像。Na'Vi 在后期击败了他们，我觉得这真的击碎了 E-Home 的信心。E-Home 打出了 GG。Na'Vi 拿下这局，他们距离捧走一百万美元只差一胜。但真正的问题是……我们第二局赢得非常勉强。

cues.en: Chinese teams generally are feared for the late game potential.
cues.zh: 中国战队通常在后期的潜力上让人忌惮。

cues.en: And Puck will be the last hero for Na'Vi, the nimble hero there already. Once again, a lot of aggressive heroes for them. Na'Vi, light of heaven, playing as the beast master again, with Denny playing as the Puck this time. If Na'Vi wins this, they win the whole tournament. This clash of the titans right here is something we will not want to miss. X will come in closer, they will be able to get that kill. Do now on Denny. Pull in by X.
cues.zh: 而Puck将成为Na'Vi的最后一位英雄，那个灵活的英雄已经就位。又一次，他们选了很多进攻性英雄。Na'Vi，light of heaven，再次操刀兽王，这次Denny玩的是Puck。如果Na'Vi赢下这场，他们就拿下整个锦标赛。这场神仙打架我们绝对不想错过。X会靠得更近，他们能拿到那个人头。现在对Denny动手。X拉过来。

cues.en: The entire E-home team turns on him. Lipsch will go down. FCB's on the run. The Volstov after the chase of him might be enough. He's more damaged. Oh! X, long jump in. Nanny homing up on the high ground. FCB, Lipsch off the wall, the ribs homing up against the kill. He's under a tree. Yes, it is. Nanny with the last right click.
cues.zh: 整个E-home队伍都转向他。Lipsch会倒下。FCB在逃跑。Volstov追他可能够了。他血量更低。哦！X，远距离跳进来。Nanny在高地上追踪。FCB，Lipsch离开墙面，肋骨追踪上来完成击杀。他在一棵树下。是的，就是这样。Nanny最后一记右键。

cues.en: Then he just went in and demolished them.
cues.zh: 然后他就冲进去把他们碾碎了。

cues.en: Now, they're on top of the tier 3 tower. They're gonna bring it down. Yes, it does. It goes down. E-herm, they're drawing desperately to defend the Na'vi. The onslaught will continue. The mid tower is already being pushed. The tier 4 tower is gonna go down. They're running in right now. There's the rest of Na'vi. They're running forward to $1 million. And they will get it. The GG is the call from E-herm. Na'vi have just won $1 billion. E-herm...
cues.zh: 现在，他们在三塔上方。他们要把它推掉。是的，推掉了。E-herm，他们拼命回防Na'Vi。猛攻还会继续。中路塔已经在被推了。四塔要倒了。他们现在冲进去了。Na'Vi剩下的人也来了。他们向前冲，冲向100万美元。他们会拿到的。E-herm打出了GG。Na'Vi刚刚赢下了10亿美元。E-herm……

cues.en: I was jumping on the sofa and screaming like crazy girl.
cues.zh: 我当时在沙发上又蹦又跳，像疯丫头一样尖叫。

cues.en: Because I was the happiest girl in the world and my brother just won 1 million dollars I think in 10 years time all the gamers which we currently have showing themselves They're gonna be the guys we all look back at and say this was the beginning. This is where it all started These are the guys that worked hard and they took the risk they proved themselves and they forwarded the entire industry to the point where we could have a kickstart we could show the world what we do and then
cues.zh: 因为我当时是世界上最幸福的女孩，我哥哥刚赢了100万美元。我觉得10年后，现在所有正在崭露头角的游戏玩家，都会成为我们回望时说“这就是起点”的那批人。一切就是从这里开始的。正是这些人努力拼搏、承担风险、证明了自己，把整个行业推进到我们能迎来起跑、能向世界展示我们所作所为的地步，然后……

cues.en: Here you notice how big we can get at that point. We've come far already. When more and more people support it and it becomes more and more normal, it's going to go from a niche to becoming accepted in societies. I think in 15 years, sports would be bigger than football, than basketball, than everything. That kid who you thought played too many video games is potentially going to be on a path where he's earning.
cues.zh: 这时你会注意到，到那时我们能发展到多大。我们已经走了很远。当越来越多人支持它、它变得越来越寻常，它就会从一个小众圈子变成被社会接受的事物。我觉得15年后，这项运动会比足球、篮球、比一切都更大。那个你觉得电子游戏打太多的孩子，可能正走上一条能赚钱的路。

cues.en: 250,000 a year salary. He's flying the world. He's going to be endorsed. Gaming's the biggest entertainment industry in the world. So if you're a star, you are potentially one of the biggest stars in the world. So if that, like everything else with computers, grows exponentially or whatever, then five or ten years could be a big step actually. Changing mindsets is never easy. So it's going to take a while when the gamers now become parents.
cues.zh: 一年25万美元薪水。他满世界飞。他会拿到代言。游戏是世界上最大的娱乐产业。所以如果你是明星，你有可能成为世界上最大的明星之一。所以如果它像计算机领域的其他一切那样指数级增长之类的，那五年或十年实际上可能就是一大步。改变观念从来不容易。所以等现在的玩家成为父母，还需要一段时间。

cues.en: we will be supportive of our kids playing. And I think that's really when everything will boom. She's definitely proud of me. I mean, just had her camera on, like, why are you taking a photo of the television? And I know she's really smart. She's a lawyer, so...
cues.zh: 我们会支持孩子们去打比赛。我觉得到那时候一切才会真正火起来。她肯定为我骄傲。我是说，她当时还开着相机，好像在说，你拍电视干嘛？我知道她特别聪明。她是律师，所以……

cues.en: But in the end, I think she'll be more understanding and be willing to support me more, so it worked out. We were disappointed with our loss, and it's a mixture of both we were happy and sad that we got third. Regardless of my emotions, I felt like she was the one I wanted to share them with, and it got pretty clear only then that I had to get her back. After the tournament, I actually went back to look for her and talk things out, and we have actually began dating again, and things are actually going great.
cues.zh: 但最后，我觉得她会更理解我，也更愿意支持我，所以结果还不错。我们对失利很失望，拿到第三名，我们既开心又难过，心情很复杂。不管我是什么情绪，我都觉得她是那个我想与之分享的人，也正是在那时我才清楚地意识到，我必须把她追回来。比赛之后，我真的回去找她，把话说开，我们确实又开始约会了，现在一切都很好。

cues.en: I love her, you know. She played a huge role, a very huge part in the me today. One week ago, it was 3,000 followers. I was happy. And when it's boom, 8,000 followers. It's not about the number. Even if one or two are fine. You don't need to show numbers, actually. I think. My father, I think...
cues.zh: 我爱她，你知道的。她在我成为今天的我这件事上起了巨大的作用，非常巨大的作用。一周前还是3000个关注者。我很开心。然后一下子爆了，8000个关注者。这不是数字的问题。哪怕只有一两个也行。其实你不需要展示数字。我觉得。我父亲，我觉得……

cues.en: didn't have time to understand what Dandy is doing. We lost him too early and if now he can see Dandy, I'm sure that he's proud of his son.
cues.zh: 没来得及弄明白Dandy在做什么。我们失去他太早了，如果现在他能看到Dandy，我相信他会为自己的儿子骄傲。
